title: Tiny Water Bears Have Survived Outer Space
description: Tardigrades are microscopic animals tough enough to survive being exposed to space.

scenes.text: There is a tiny animal that has survived a trip into outer space. It is the tardigrade, also called the water bear.
scenes.subject: tardigrade
scenes.say: [excited] There is a tiny animal that has survived a trip into OUTER SPACE. It is the tardigrade, also called the water bear.

scenes.text: Tardigrades are smaller than a millimeter long and live almost everywhere, even in the moss on a garden wall.
scenes.subject: moss
scenes.say: Tardigrades are smaller than a millimeter long and live almost everywhere, even in the moss on a garden wall.

scenes.text: In two thousand seven, scientists sent some into orbit and exposed them to the vacuum of space. Some survived and even had babies afterward.
scenes.say: In two thousand seven, scientists sent some into orbit and exposed them to the vacuum of space. [gasps] Some survived and even had babies afterward.

scenes.text: When conditions get harsh, they dry out and curl up into a tiny ball, almost shutting down their bodies until things get better.
scenes.subject: tardigrade
scenes.say: [softly] When conditions get harsh, they dry out and curl up into a tiny ball, almost shutting down their bodies until things get better.

scenes.text: The toughest animal on Earth might be living in your garden. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: moss
scenes.say: [chuckles] The toughest animal on Earth might be living in your garden. Follow for more weird facts.
